# Three.js r170 (0.170.0)

Vendored from the official npm package: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.170.0.tgz

The ES module build and the postprocessing dependencies used by the visualizer are included.
The CAD viewer also uses the matching GLTFLoader, OrbitControls and BufferGeometryUtils addons.
Bare `three` imports in the addons are rewritten to relative local imports.
No CDN access is needed at runtime. MIT license: see LICENSE.
